notes: Burmese is matched without word boundaries, so every term is a multi-syllable compound and nothing is a fragment of an everyday word; the decoy လူထု is untouched. Deliberately dropped: bare ဝယ်ယူ (procure/buy), which fires on any consumer-purchasing sentence; bare ပြင်ဆင် (amend), which also means repair/prepare, so only the noun ပြင်ဆင်ချက် is kept; bare တင်သွင်း (submit a bill), which doubles as 'import'; bare ဘောက်ချာ (voucher), which is everyday for a receipt; bare အစီအစဉ် (programme), which also means a TV schedule; and bare ထောက်ပံ့, which is a prefix of the instrument term ထောက်ပံ့ကြေး. Institution names such as လွှတ်တော် were left out on purpose, since they name an actor rather than an action. Verb entries carry the -သည် / -ခဲ့ / -မည် / -ရန် / -မှု endings Burmese headlines print.
